Currently, only NetSocketUnix implements AF_UNIX. If someone who has access to a Windows machine would like to do it, that would be awesome.

My intention, short-term, is to use it for embedded debugging, as it will reduce the latency if all the messages sent between the processes
This was an optimisation to avoid multiple hash table lookups.
I've created a common base, `RemoteDebuggerPeerSocket` that has all the common behaviour
This allows the `NetSocket` to distinguish the address family as either INET or UNIX
I'll take a look, implementation should be almost the same as Unix, `AF_UNIX` should be supported since Redstone 4 so it should be fine to use it with a Windows version check.
